notes: Unjess v3.1.3 - Project Removal with Confirmation Dialog & Hidden-by-Default Right Inspector Sidebar.

changelog.title: Unjess v3.1.3 - Project Removal with Confirmation Dialog & Hidden-by-Default Right Sidebar
changes: Added project removal button (trash icon) on project folders in the left sidebar and workspace switcher dropdown with a dedicated confirmation modal before removing the project and its chat sessions

Changed the Right Inspector sidebar (Diffs | Browser | Controls) to start hidden by default on startup for a cleaner, distraction-free chat workspace (still opens on demand or when toggling Browser / Inspector)

changelog.title: Unjess v3.1.2 - Automatic Update Polling, Top-Bar Restart & Update Button & Quick Chats Fix
changes: Added prominent one-click 'Restart & Update (vX.Y.Z)' button directly in the top header bar whenever a new version is available
Added automatic background update polling (on startup and every 15 minutes) across both unjess.si and the GitHub release manifest so new releases appear automatically
Fixed Quick Chats being absorbed into the Projects folder tree when given custom titles or reloaded across daemon restarts
Synchronized both Unjess.exe and unjess-desktop.exe sibling binaries during in-app updates with automatic .old backup cleanup on restart

changelog.title: Unjess v3.1.1 - Response Clarity, Cross-Turn Memory Retention, Model Search & Starred Favorites
changes: Eliminated cross-turn tool history amnesia: buildConversationHistoryMessages now preserves all file-mutating tool calls and final verification steps instead of dropping calls after step 12
Fixed CompactConversation live-turn struct extraction, auto-attached PLAN.md into <workspace_overview>, and silenced pre-exit scratch cleanup so internal checks never hijack user-facing replies

Added Antigravity / OpenCode communication & work-efficiency protocol (direct answer first, clear 'What Works vs. What Is Missing' structure, batched commands, and no unsolicited desktop GUI hijacking)
Added instant multi-token Model Search, ★ Starred model pinning (persisted to config.yaml), GFM Markdown table/list/link renderer, and separate 'Ollama Cloud (Local)' vs. 'Ollama API' routing

changelog.title: Unjess v3.1.0 - Native Sidebar Browser (WebView2), Persistent Sessions & Transient Retry Hardening
changes: Added embedded Native Sidebar Browser (child WebView2) docked in the Right Inspector (Diffs | Browser | Controls) — zero iframe restrictions, real GPU rendering, persistent logins, and no headless CDP bot flags
Added instant multi-token Model Search (with Arrow/Enter keyboard navigation) and Starred Favorites (★ Starred always pinned to the top across selectors and persisted to config.yaml)
Separated local Ollama Cloud (:cloud) models into 'Ollama Cloud (Local)' routed via local localhost:11434 vs direct 'Ollama API' (ollama.com)

Added automatic exponential backoff retries for transient upstream LLM errors (503, 429, 502, 504, 529), orphaned workspace pruning, workspace removal endpoints, and skill folder frontmatter normalization

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.9 - Workspace Context Isolation & Opt-In Strict Workspace Sandbox
changes: Scoped buildRecentSessionsSummary strictly to the active workspace so unrelated project sessions and snippets no longer leak into prompts
Changed memory_save default scope to 'workspace' and enforced exact normalized workspace boundaries in SearchMemories and FormatForSystemPrompt

Added opt-in Strict Workspace Sandbox toggle (OFF by default in Settings, Right Inspector Controls, and CLI /sandbox) locking reads, writes, searches, visual QA, and shell command paths strictly to the active workspace

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.8 - Collapsible Sidebar Folders & Sections + Finish-Reply Scroll Fix
changes: Made individual project folders collapsible so nested conversations under each workspace can be toggled cleanly with persistent state
Added collapsible Projects and Quick Chats section headers to hide sidebar clutter while preserving workspace conversation grouping

Fixed chat viewport jumping up to the user prompt or top of thread when AI finishes replying (removed off-layout content-visibility sizing drift, added overflow-anchor: none, and tracked user scroll intent)

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.7 - Model-Aware Auto-Compaction, 250k Context Ceiling & Overflow Recovery
changes: Wired model-aware auto-compaction honoring enable_compaction (~65% of model context, capped at 250k tokens on 1M+ windows like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Gemini)
Connected KV-cache-friendly warm-prefix LLM summarization (with deterministic 8-section fallback) and auto-compacts conversation history beyond 24 turns instead of dropping turns silently
Scaled intra-turn tool pruning thresholds proportionally per model and added automatic context_length_exceeded overflow recovery

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.6 - Bundle WebView2Loader.dll in Windows Installer & Portable ZIP
changes: Embedded WebView2Loader.dll inside Unjess-Setup.exe so Unjess.exe launches cleanly after installation without missing DLL errors
Added dynamic Windows Known-Folder Desktop shortcut resolution (supports OneDrive Desktop redirection) and explicit install path confirmation
Published self-contained Unjess-Portable-win64.zip with Unjess.exe, WebView2Loader.dll, unjessd.exe, and unjess-cli.exe side-by-side

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.5 - Fresh Desktop Shell Build, Resource Version & Installer Sync
changes: Rebuilt Unjess.exe desktop shell and embedded UI fallback from current source instead of legacy v2.9.0/v3.0.0 assets
Updated Windows PE resource version metadata in Unjess.exe, unjessd.exe, and unjess-cli.exe from v2.9.6/v3.0.4 to v3.0.5
Synchronized installer scripts, version manifests, and Caddy/unjess.si release redirects with SHA-256 verified v3.0.5 binaries

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.4 - Ollama API UI Rename & Provider Selection Persistence Fix
changes: Renamed 'Ollama Cloud' labels to 'Ollama API' across Settings, model selectors, and backend model discovery
Fixed setModel() and Save All Settings resetting Active LLM Provider from ollama-api back to local ollama when selecting hosted Ollama API models
Preserved ollama-api selection across syncs/saves when an Ollama API key is configured, and added automatic :cloud fallback to OllamaAPIBaseURL when local Ollama is offline

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.3 - Ollama Cloud Routing & Live Model Discovery Fix
changes: Preserved explicit ollama-api provider in DetectProvider so :cloud and hosted Ollama Cloud models route to OllamaAPIBaseURL instead of local Ollama or Qwen
Added live Ollama Cloud (/api/tags) Bearer-authenticated model discovery and normalized Ollama Cloud base URL handling
Added dedicated Ollama Cloud Base URL Fetch button and accurate per-endpoint model counts in Settings

changelog.title: Unjess v3.0.2 - Prototype Rewrite in Go and Rust Wry
changes: Go daemon (unjessd) and Rust Wry desktop wrapper with ~10 MB combined footprint
Multi-provider routing: local/cloud Ollama and direct provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini)
ReAct agent loop with fuzzy JSON argument auto-repair for common LLM syntax slip-ups
Model Context Protocol (MCP) client and custom skills execution
Persistent file-based workspace memory and session tracking
